build_parser_cli: build the argparse parser for the voxcpm CLI with design, clone, and batch subcommands
load_model_voxcpm: load a VoxCPM model from a local path or Hugging Face Hub with device and optimization options
detect_model_architecture: detect the VoxCPM model architecture from a local config.json or Hugging Face model ID string
run_main_design: run the voxcpm CLI design subcommand to generate speech from text with an optional control prompt
run_main_clone: run the voxcpm CLI clone subcommand to clone a voice from prompt audio with a transcript file
run_main_batch: run the voxcpm CLI batch subcommand to generate speech from a text file with control prompts
validate_clone_args: validate clone subcommand arguments requiring prompt audio with transcript or reference audio
validate_design_args: validate design subcommand arguments rejecting prompt and reference audio inputs
